leadText:
This is the eighth chapter of the Pokémon Mezastar: Aim to Be a Tag Master! manga. It was first published in the February 2022 issue of CoroCoro Ichiban!, released on December 21, 2021. It is 18 pages long.

It was made available on Weekly CoroCoro Comics on July 15, 2022.
